description: StylePTB (Lyu et al., NAACL 2021) parallel style-transfer pairs across 15 of the 21 single-transform subtypes. Each record is a length-2 ordered list [target, source] grouped under the subtype label; order_alignment tests whether embeddings separate the two style sides despite shared content. See loader.py for the full subtype table, the rationale for the 6 dropped subtypes, and the PTB-tokenization caveat.
